acc_def: greedy after '###' (<= 12 tokens, stop at EOS / newline), bench.tasks.norm_number exact match; the text arm generates its CoT to '###' first

struct.def: theory/gsmtpl/seen_split.py's functional fingerprint (extra_stats.fingerprint at two random value vectors + m) seen in Aug train (unfiltered)

dedupe.def: gsmlen/dedupe.py: lower-case, numbers -> #, word 8-grams; score = max over Aug train items of shared / test shingles (shingles in >= 5000 items skipped); flagged >= 0.5

filler.def: prepended to the question; exactly 16 / 32 GPT-2 tokens incl. the trailing space

fit.def: fit_fix: 1000 train items (rng 20010) as drawn; fit_rs: one fresh R_x draw (rng 20011) of each recomputable one, accepted draws only

aux_exact_by_grounding.def: §202 P-W8: the aux_exact_by_pass items split by step t's operand grounding (gsm8k_data.parse_recomputable on the test raw item): R = any operand is a previous result, Q = question literals / constants only, unparsed = item not recomputable

aux_suite.def: §204 §8.4: per source (Mt / M1 (pass-token arms) / M0 / COUNTER-SWAP cs_*), by pass t <= min(m, 8, K): value_exact (value / factor arms; greedy value after the aux prompt, decoded and compared with the gold RHS as a STRING (note 204-3); value_exact_tokid = token-id equality), op_acc / ptr1_acc / ptr2_acc (factor heads), or the string arm's value_in_string / op_in_string / ptr1_in_string from its greedy ' <<lhs=rhs>>'; ptr*_nocollide = items whose candidate set has no first-BPE-token collision; *_by_grounding = R / Q / unparsed

lotus_sep.def: note 204-5: level-1 steps (grounding Q), decoded from M_1 with P_t; value = string equality (string arm: value_in_string); plan = mean of the present op / ptr1 / ptr2 hits (string arm: op_in_string / ptr1_in_string); items m <= 2 vs m >= 4; pooled over t <= min(m, 8, K)
